meta_description:
28K likes, 793 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 17, 2026: "It is strange how even work desks can hold so many memories. 
Of a version of you that you vaguely remember but deeply cherish ♥️

I’m so grateful to younger Tanya for having the courage and determination to do this repeatedly, over and over again.

I’ve worked from so many corners, homes and desks over the years. Some were proper setups, some were very much ‘make it work’ situations.

But looking back I’ve realised that the setup was never the important part. It was the will power, the ideas, the consistency. And honestly, just starting somewhere

If you’ve been thinking about starting your own creator journey,  learn from someone who’s seen it all, tested it all, been doing it consistently for years! And can help you with real evidence to make your journey smooth 

So I’m hosting the next @juststartschool workshop live on 26th September 2026 at 10 AM! 

I’ll talk about finding content styles, ideation, shooting, editing, storytelling and actually getting started as a creator.

Sign up link is in my bio!".
